The '''Tyrena Starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:TS" /> [[Amarent Loren]], a member of the [[Corellian Port Authority]], worked at the Tyrena Starport during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:SC" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Tyrena Starport was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
